item.title: Economists See Final ECB Hike Next Week in Split With Markets
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: Bulgaria’s Dimitar Radev referred to both September and December as “live” meetings where borrowing costs could be lifted. The ECB “is unlikely to signal any further interest-rate increases in the coming months,” said Ulrike Kastens, senior economist at DWS International. “However, we believe that the risks surrounding the next policy move remain skewed to the upside, with a rate hike appearing more likely than a rate cut.”
